summary: Every typed endpoint MCP tool (internal/mcp/tools.go, via the renamed makeAPIHandlerVerbose -- makeAPIHandler and makeAPIHandlerStripFields are now thin wrappers over it) declares and honors a "select" argument, applying the same dotted-path projection (cli.FilterFieldsJSON) this CLI's --select flag already uses, before the response reaches MCP result-budget bounding. classes_catalog, classes_search, classes_show, and classes_structure additionally declare include_stream_urls and include_instructor_bios (both default false) and, when unset, deep-strip a fixed field-name list (stream/playback URLs, join_tokens, image_url, instructor bio/short_bio/ordered_q_and_as/workout_share_images) from the response at any nesting depth via the new deepStripFields helper. Any future regen of these tools must keep select wired into makeAPIHandlerVerbose's shared pipeline (stripFields -> verboseToggles -> select -> bound rendering) and keep classes_catalog/classes_search/classes_show/classes_structure passing classesVerboseToggles, or a caller loses both the ability to shrink an oversized response and the improved default size.
reason: Live-tested against a deployed instance: a 100-item classes_search(browse_category=cycling, class_type_id=<theme>, limit=100) result measured 454,819 bytes against a 60,000-byte MCP tool budget (7.58x over, truncated and unusable), roughly 4.5 KB/class. The bulk was fixed per-call cost unrelated to the query: per-class stream/playback URLs and join tokens, plus complete instructor records (full bio, ordered Q&A, a 12-entry mostly-identical default Strava placeholder image array) repeated for every instructor in the result set. The report's own priority list named this the biggest practical win for agent callers, with select -- already proven working on offline/search tools -- as "the model this should copy," since it's the caller-controlled complement to server-side default stripping.
validated_outcome: go build/vet/test/govulncheck and verify_skill.py all green. New tests: TestDeepStripFieldsRemovesNamedKeysAtAnyDepth and TestDeepStripFieldsIsNoOpOnInvalidJSONOrEmptyFieldList cover the new helper directly; TestClassesSearchDefaultsStripVerboseFieldsUnlessIncluded confirms the default-stripped fields are gone while unrelated fields (id, title, instructor name) survive; TestClassesCatalogAndSearchDeclareSelectAndVerboseToggles and TestAllTypedEndpointToolsDeclareSelect assert the tool schemas declare the right argument names and JSON Schema types across all ten typed endpoint tools. Deferred, pending live shape confirmation this environment can't provide: collapsing instructor records to {id,name} (vs. the current bio/Q&A/share-image field deletion, which keeps other instructor fields like id/name/username intact) and collapsing user_caption_locales into captions' locale codes -- both need to know the live response's exact container shape more precisely than field-name-based deletion requires, so they're left as follow-up work rather than guessed at.
